notes.title: [Dev Note] Weapons of Remore
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792072/4359f13464d70583210fab7bf83bd02ec8ea598a.jpg[/img]

Last time, we looked at how to prepare for combat and how the battle itself unfolds. 

Today, we’re going to dive into one of the most important elements of battle in Remore: Infested Kingdom, the weapons

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792072/22ba7c138d6c64b02c1ac0c2599bbec009a416fc.png[/img]

What we consider important when developing the weapons for Remore, is that they each have a unique role that affects how the game is played and also that they match the setting of our world.  

To that end we decided :

[list]
[*] Our weapons should be based on real medieval weapons to give the feeling that in Remore, the survivors are living through a real medieval apocalypse.
[*] Weapons should have the characteristic of ‘manipulating the battlefield’ which is the basis of the way the game is played.
[/list]

When choosing weapons for our game we checked that they would satisfy both of these conditions.

We identified and organized the features of medieval weapons by referencing various media, including other medieval focused games and also anything we could find that talked about the construction and reproduction of these kinds of weapons. 

After researching the weapons and thinking about how to interpret their features we selected those that we felt gave us a broad selection of characteristics that we could use to form a deep and challenging combat system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792072/5fcfe03cff1b8031badfed4d4d1632894f2576be.png[/img]

In the end we selected 14 weapons which ranged from more commonly used weapons like swords and morning stars to ones which would be used in a desperate situation like a pitch-fork or cleaver.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792072/7f654a26ab54f3cfe4a44ed8fdf2c4de01c84c92.gif[/img]

The first weapon we’ll take a look at is the ‘two-handed sword’.  The two-handed sword is one of the most destructive weapons in our game, with powerful attack skills such as a wide ranging swing which damages all enemies caught in its path or an attack capable of delivering a devastating blow to a single enemy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792072/ef871579757ade9ab867cf6e19532f35a1fc3d6b.gif[/img]

The ‘bill hook’ is an interesting weapon that we learned about while playing Battle Brothers, which has a unique shape and ability which makes it stand out from other weapons. It’s a very useful weapon which can manipulate the battlefield in a variety of ways such as pulling an opponent towards the user using the hook or attacking multiple enemies using its long pole range.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792072/0a4b2eaa9779e9d4f1f02bc36a379afd812cb267.gif[/img]

The shield is a secondary piece of equipment which focuses on defense. However, in Remore, the shield is not just capable of defense but also a weapon that can shove or attack enemies. 

The above weapons represent the overall battle progress in our game, attack, battlefield manipulation and defense. In addition to these, various other weapons will have strengths and weaknesses when dealing with the various Infested you will come across throughout play.

That’s just a taste of what’s to come. To check out these as well as the unique capabilities and features of other weapons, keep an eye out for the upcoming demo that we’re currently working hard on putting together for you!

Until then, we hope you’ll join us next time when we’ll introduce the survivors who are going to be brandishing the weapons we showed today.

notes.title: [Dev Note] Battle #2 : In Combat
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792072/4359f13464d70583210fab7bf83bd02ec8ea598a.jpg[/img]

Once the player falls into an enemy's line of sight and is swarmed by the alerted Infested, the battle begins!

As seen in the example battle below, the basic type of combat that we want the player to experience is one where they are outnumbered. 

The [b]arrow[/b] next to the enemy indicates [b]the direction[/b] they are facing. The enemy will [b]grab[/b] the character that they are next to and facing. So, in the example below the Knight Errant and Militia are grabbed by two Infested and the Outsider by one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792072/d4a5c4e72b489572953d32df4edcd0437485b2de.png[/img]

In keeping with the theme and to reinforce the sense of desperation, the survivors' physical strength is low. Even the most basic variant of Infested, the Knawer, can put a survivor in a critical state with just a couple of attacks.

However, since a character [b]cannot move[/b] once caught, special tactical action is required. These actions will cost one of two types of Action Points.


[b][h3]Weapon Action Point[/h3][/b]
"Weapon Action Points - or WP" are used for weapon action based skills. Every character has [b]two[/b] per turn.

One handed weapons use [b]1[/b] point for attack and two handed weapons use [b]2[/b]. This limits the possibilities of attack so careful planning is required to get the best result!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792072/7bd3edd6e2eee0b8cd43de2fcfdcc915f8f54dfc.png[/img]

Above are two weapon skills of the Outsider’s starting weapon, the Woodcutter’s axe.

Axe Slash will attack all enemies in a single line. Ambush Chop will only attack a single enemy but attacking when [b]out of sight[/b] will greatly increase the chance of a critical attack.

Looking at the previous battle, if the Outsider uses Axe Slash he can only attack two infested of the three possible for this skill. However, one of the Infested is looking at the Militia so using Ambush Chop would take advantage of its ability.

Leading onto the next feature, using ‘Tactical Action Points - or TP’ will yield better results in this situation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792072/4bb0a27a2f165a241b6ff60755b73c9ed626ddea.png[/img]

[h3][b]Tactical Action Point) [/b][/h3]

Using TP, you can use your attack opportunities more efficiently, as seen below

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792072/39dfecd6e5838b02be43ad074902d98d91d52700.gif[/img]

Since the player has used their TP to push and pull the enemies into position the Outsider was able to attack 3 enemies at once using their Axe Slash skill.  

TP is a resource consumed by movement at a cost of 1 TP per tile. However, in battle there are separate skills that can be used which also draw on this resource. 

[list]
[*] [b]Push[/b] (Common) : Push a nearby enemy 1 space.
[*] [b]Swift Save[/b] (Knight) : Swap places with an ally. (Available when grabbed)
[*] [b]Rope Pull[/b] (Militia) : Pull an enemy of ally 1 space in the direction of the user.
[*] [b]Second Wind[/b] (Outsider) : Restore WP by 2.
[/list]
The key to surviving combat is to manipulate the battlefield by pushing enemies who have caught an ally, pulling enemies away from a threatened ally or even pulling an ally out of harm’s way. Then when the stage is set, use WP effectively to take out as many enemies in one turn as possible. 

As the game progresses, the types of weapon skills using WP and tactical skills using TP become more and more diverse and as such the depth of tactical play also increases.

Join us next time, when we will take a deeper dive into the game's contents including a look at weapons and character perks!

notes.title: [Dev Note] Pre-Combat Gameplay
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792072/4359f13464d70583210fab7bf83bd02ec8ea598a.jpg[/img]

The jumping off point when starting the combat design was to ask ourselves, how can we deliver the feeling of being thrown into a medieval apocalyptic land? 

As we were trying to make a solid tactical gameplay, it was obvious that we needed a deep and challenging combat system, but this alone wouldn’t be enough - recklessly pushing forward and engaging in combat wouldn’t be a realistic response for survivors in this situation.

For this reason we’ve implemented the [b]Fog of War[/b] and [b]Line of Sight [/b]system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792072/8d82f91a0c9709e04bc51cc967267141032b7747.png[/img]

The battle sessions mostly take place indoors. The main reason you confront with the Infested is to find [b]supplies[/b] - food, weapons, bandages, etc. That means that you will have to visit places like a village, a tavern, and a monastery to scavenge the items, breaching doors all while running the risk of encountering the enemies.

You won’t know exactly what lurks in the battlefield - out of each player characters’ sight range, the maps are covered by [b]darkness[/b], the Fog of War (FoW). You will have to  approach a location to see exactly how many enemies are there, and decide where and when to trigger the battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792072/bb0fa58a01535b01265be687eaa96efbaf28608f.png[/img]

Each enemy has their own Line of Sight (LoS), and the player can check their direction and range in the grid-based game UI. Once one of the player characters is spotted...

...Every enemy nearby will be alerted, and will chase and grab your characters even if it’s not their turn.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792072/de3b24afa0ac5000e580e1ebc9227aa7f43f223e.png[/img]

These are the basics of the pre-combat gameplay system. 

[list]
[*] To gather supplies or achieve the mission goal, you have to explore the darkness (FoW).
[list]
[*]Sometimes there will be a surprise encounter waiting behind doors or around the corner, so take caution.[/list]
[*] Before you are spotted by the enemy LoS, you need to prepare the formation you want.
[list]
[*] Find a zone where your characters won’t be outnumbered, but from where you can attack enemies effectively based on your weapon's range.[/list][/list]
In our next post, we will show the actual combat features. Looking forward to seeing you then!

notes.title: [Dev note] What in the world ?!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792072/4359f13464d70583210fab7bf83bd02ec8ea598a.jpg[/img]

Grab your sword and shield and delve into the land of Remore, fighting and surviving an infestation of insect-like creatures not of this earth!

The setting of Remore is a fictional medieval land, divided by harsh times, corrupt lords and leaders and warring neighboring lands. If this wasn’t hard enough, the people of Remore suffer an apocalyptic calamity when a massive tear rips open the sky and casts the land into permanent darkness. 


[h3][b]Infested…[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792072/2d74d1449f7bb777e418d7093df99bcd1d78848f.png[/img]

With the light extinguished and panic spreading, vile creatures the people call Infested emerge from the darkness and begin savagely attacking all in sight. These creatures are grotesque beings that seem a nightmarish mix of people and insects. They lurk through the night massacring all they cross.

But where did these creatures come from? Why do they bear similarities to us humans?  Did they emerge from the tear? Or is there something even worse waiting out there?… Something creating these infested creatures?…Something that wants us dead…

These are the questions the survivors will ask in time…Or maybe like it or not…the answers will find them..   


[h3][b]Meet the survivors…[/b][/h3]

Out of the bloody slaughter emerge an unlikely band of survivors, coming together out of a will to survive. 

Willam, a former Knight and reluctant savior out to avenge his wife and protect those he can.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792072/f350a1c621651c12b84b43592842d61f86c4d1c8.gif[/img]

Edwin, a fresh faced soldier not weeks out of training struggling to find his courage in face of this horror.

Diurmuid a foreigner from a neighboring land at war with Remore, who’s true motives are eyed with suspicion…

You will meet these them and many more...

In REMORE : INFESTED KINGDOM We’re trying to create characters who the player wishes to learn more about and who has a story that unfolds over the course of the playthrough. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792072/0384e1f145e22a2e3b9f62a0e5a64a22ace74bba.gif[/img]


[h3][b]Inspiration/Infestation[/b][/h3]

When the project started out our narrative and story naturally seemed to flow in the direction of a medieval zombie apocalypse, but we really struggled to make the story and concept seem fresh and so decided to try a new direction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792072/55cb4c204cc6085a1e09c8e9df8848799ebfbb18.gif[/img]

The idea came to us, well if the creatures aren’t going to be zombies what are they? From this question came ideas more focused on creatures as ‘alien’ like entities that come from somewhere unknown. 

We found this exciting and fresh and ran with it. A lot of the narrative points of interest came about from this ‘medieval invasion/infestation idea’ and without spoiling too much of where we are going with it, we think it’s a cool concept that we’re enjoying working with and hope players will find unique and enjoyable too! We’re excited for you to jump in and have fun with our world, our narrative, and our characters!

notes.title: [Dev Note] First Look of REMORE: INFESTED KINGDOM
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792072/4359f13464d70583210fab7bf83bd02ec8ea598a.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Hello, Survivors.[/b][/h3]

More than two years have passed since we first revealed the concept image of our medieval apocalypse pixel-art tactical RPG, the project ‘Before the Dawn’.

So far we’ve established the base mechanic of the game, and fleshed out content that can generate the experience we were trying to achieve - a highly tactical game engaging to genre fans, while thematically immersive to give the feeling of being thrown to the peril of medieval apocalypse.

Now that our detailed narrative and gameplay mechanics are ready to reveal, we’ve decided to make the name of the game in the world itself : [b]Remore, the Infested Kingdom.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792072/cef00b2011bb138e784ac82ef5b755a93bcfb5bc.gif[/img]

[h3][b]So, what is the game?[/b][/h3]
At its core the genre is a tactical RPG, controlling three characters in a given turn. 

[list]
[*] Willam the Knight Errant, who protects the party with his shield.
[*] Diurmuid the Outsider, master of two-handed weapons dealing with multiple enemies.
[*] Edwin the Militia, supports other members with spears and bows.
[/list]
However, we thought that characters should not be heroes with overwhelming power to support the theme. No magic, no superpowers.

What’s in your hand to beat the Infested are only the medieval weapons, so you have to always find a way not to be outnumbered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792072/3faf08d266a4b33b2752201bc00c454cd36bfc69.gif[/img]

Enemies won’t just stand still on your turn - they will [b]spot[/b] the movement of survivors, then [b]chase and grab[/b] them even when it’s not their turn. They are hidden in corners or behind unopened doors, so you have to always take a cautious step.

You can also use enemies’ [b]line of sight and noise[/b] to trigger the battle on your terms. Throw a stone to attract attention or set up a tall barricade to prevent them from spotting the survivors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792072/1b4c76bb1b43a1da0a5587baec61318237216efd.gif[/img]

On top of this base mechanic, the gameplay will be unlike any others in the genre : The tactical session is about how and when to engage the battle, and how to control the battlefield as you want.

We will keep it short for now, and introduce detailed features of the game along with the lore and narrative side.

If you’re interested, you can follow us on Twitter! Looking forward to seeing you again in this post.
